messages:
Sasha: Seeing tenant bleed on the dashboard after switching org in the picker. Repro ~80%.
Jin: can you paste repro steps + browser? :eyes:
Sasha: Steps:
1) open /console/dashboards
2) pick Org A
3) open card "Recent runs"
4) switch to Org B via top-right
5) card still shows rows from Org A. Screenshot: https://redwood/s/abc123
Priya: are cards prefetched? could be cache key missing org id
Sasha: looks like prefetch. Server log snippet shows old org used despite new auth token.
Sasha: ```GET /api/dashboard/card?id=recent&limit=10
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer eyJ... (user token, Org=98765)
  X-Org-ID: 98765
  Cookie: prefetch_org=54321; org_affinity=54321

Query executed: SELECT * FROM runs WHERE org_id = 54321 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10
``` 
Marco: very likely cookie-based prefetch + cache key mismatch. routing policy falls back to cached response when backend slower; prefetch cookie still pointing at Org A so server returned cached Org A rows.
Priya: right — the fast-prefetch change omitted org_id from the cache key on SSR path. bad tradeoff.
Jin: telemetry shows a deploy 2026-03-18T09:12:00Z by ops-bot that changed prefetch cache behavior.
ops-bot: deployed console-prefetch v2.7.4 to canary (10%) at 09:12 UTC
Priya: mitigation: clear prefetch cookie on org switch client-side, and patch server to include tenant_id in cache key and to prefer explicit X-Org/X-Tenant headers over cookies.
Jin: add e2e: switchOrg -> assert each card's fetch has X-Org and response rows filtered to that org
Sasha: I'll open PR for client clear + server change + unit tests. Will canary, monitor traces for 'org_mismatch'.
Marco: also add a permanent trace tag 'tenant_id' on dashboard fetch spans so we can alert on header vs response mismatch.
Priya: rollout plan: canary 10% -> 25% -> 100%, alert if mismatch rate > 0.5% in any 15m window -> rollback.
Sasha: will file a short incident doc with timeline + reproducer. tagging eng-platform and eng-oncall.
Jin: I'll run canary and ping #eng-oncall before ramp. :shipit:
devex-bot: note: bumping console client minor sdk version due to cookie-clear change
Priya: FYI quota-routing investigations show quota policy not implicated here, keeping separate.
Sasha: assigning follow-ups: PR by Sasha, rollout by Jin, telemetry + trace tags by Marco. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
